info.name: Iroad — Mobile Driver API (Unified Dashboard)
info.description:
Postman collection for the **Unified Driver Dashboard** (live calls + reference examples).

## Base path
`{{base_url}}` (default `http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1/mobile`).

## Auth
Set **`{{access_token}}`** (Bearer). Login via `POST {{base_url}}/driver/auth/login/` outside this collection.

## Folders
- **02 — Driver Dashboard (Live)** — live API including **ETag / 304** polling.
- **03 — Dashboard Examples (Reference)** — saved bodies (`sync_metadata` v2, `workflow_integrity`, `compliance_integrity`).

## Polling (fleet-scale)
1. **Get Dashboard** — on 200, saves `ETag` → `{{dashboard_etag}}` and `content_hash` → `{{dashboard_content_hash}}`.
2. **Get Dashboard (If-None-Match)** — sends `If-None-Match: {{dashboard_etag}}`; expect **304** when unchanged (empty body, `ETag` header echoed).

## Headers
| Header | Notes |
|--------|--------|
| `Authorization` | `Bearer {{access_token}}` |
| `If-None-Match` | Optional — polling only |
| `X-Tenant-ID` | Optional; must match JWT when sent |

## RBAC
`mobile.driver.dashboard` (driver role).

Unified dashboard: `GET /driver/dashboard/`

Orchestrates booking job, empty move, workflow (Action Master), POD/COD + **compliance_integrity**, timeline preview, alerts, and **sync_metadata v2** (offline cache / replay hints).

**Polling:** Run **Get Dashboard** first, then **Get Dashboard (If-None-Match)** to verify 304 when data unchanged.
